document_data.title: Pre-Authorization Letter for Knee Surgery
document_data.content:
Patient Name: Ava Morales
Date of Birth: 1984-03-12
Insurance Provider: Harbor Health, Member ID: HH-88122

Summary of Imaging Findings:
The MRI of the right knee performed on 2026-09-20 revealed a complex medial meniscal tear with a displaced fragment. However, an addendum on 2026-09-25 stated that upon further review, the medial meniscal tear was overstated as an artifact; no discrete meniscal tear is identified on the current MRI.

Surgical Need:
Despite the updated findings, the indication for knee arthroscopy remains due to persistent right knee pain and instability suspicion. The surgical intervention is necessary for further evaluation and potential repair to address ongoing symptoms and improve quality of life.
